entry_condition: support exists but SAR structure is weak/no-structure
allowed_interpretation: optical support exists and needs SAR observation follow-up
not_allowed_interpretation: do not call this a target or final box
main_failure_mode: support does not isolate SAR structure
next_validation_needed: inspect whether range/azimuth support is too broad or SAR crop is weak

entry_condition: SAR morphology exists without current optical object counterpart
allowed_interpretation: use as SAR morphology/reference pool only
not_allowed_interpretation: do not mix into optical-SAR correspondence

entry_condition: limited support plus non-final SAR structure
not_allowed_interpretation: not final annotation or identity truth

entry_condition: optical ambiguity, duplicate/handoff, or review-only state
allowed_interpretation: manual/review anchor may be separate provenance
main_failure_mode: optical object hypothesis quality is unresolved

entry_condition: current-frame optical detection dropout or severe truncation
not_allowed_interpretation: do not mix into clean paired morphology
next_validation_needed: separate dropout recovery and SAR support audit

entry_condition: SAR cluster does not persist as a usable tube
not_allowed_interpretation: do not trust single-frame bright peak

entry_condition: top1/top2 or local peaks remain too competitive
allowed_interpretation: peak competition explains why top1 is insufficient
not_allowed_interpretation: do not tune a top-k selector
next_validation_needed: structure grouping instead of top-k optimization

entry_condition: SAR structure exists but optical object hypothesis is ambiguous
allowed_interpretation: SAR can support review but not settle optical identity
next_validation_needed: optical tracklet quality and review anchor

entry_condition: optical support exists but SAR structure is diffuse/ambiguous
allowed_interpretation: hold as weak evidence or review-required
not_allowed_interpretation: do not force an association candidate
next_validation_needed: visual SAR exemplar inspection and vocabulary refinement

entry_condition: posthoc support, SAR structure, and gates are jointly plausible
not_allowed_interpretation: not identity truth and not final annotation
